name: Ookami Shoujo to Issho
source:
On a full moon, you rescued a timid puppy,
that is to say a puppy-human thing... indeed, she was a lupine.

That night was the beginning of a wild and sexy new life!
Eating together, bathing together, rompy naughty things together... it's a life of romance!
We also have our quarrels but, she's ever so perky!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE139061.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在满月之夜，你救下了一只胆怯的小狗——不，更准确地说，是某种半人半犬的生物……没错，她是一名狼族少女。

那一夜，狂野而色气的新生活拉开了序幕！
一起吃饭、一起洗澡、一起做些淘气的事……这就是恋爱生活！
虽然我们也会吵架，但她总是精神十足！

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE139061.html]DLsite English[/url]]
